title: Trump Reveals the Phrase that Goes Through His Mind When He Wakes Up as His Hectic Daily Routine as President is Unveiled | The Gateway Pundit | by Cullen Linebarger
text: TGP readers will have noticed that President Trump never seems to tire or need much rest. Now, details have emerged, partially explaining why. The United States, for the last four years, went without an actual president as Joe Biden was too mentally shot and sleepy to perform actual daily functions and had to rely on his handlers to run the country. How often did we hear of a pressing crisis with no response from the then-White House occupant? But Trump got to work right when he walked into the Oval Office. Not only has he signed hundreds of executive orders well into the evening to undo Biden’s legacy, but he is also firing Deep State officials who have been holding the country hostage daily, if not hourly. Here is how New York Post’s Miranda Devine describes his daily routine. Talk about the polar opposite of Old Joe Biden! In the renewed vigor of the Oval Office, President Trump doesn’t take meetings in the traditional sense, where one guest leaves before another departs. Instead, in gregarious fashion, the president rolls one meeting into another and introduces the principals to each other, creating a burst of high-energy chemistry and humor that has transformed the White House from a mausoleum into a symphony of personal interaction. He has shaken so many hands that the back of his right hand is almost permanently adorned with a large skin-colored Band-Aid to cover bruises and scratches from enthusiastic well-wishers. His days start at 6 a.m, and often end close to midnight over small convivial dinners in the White House with assorted dignitaries. Left unmentioned is that Trump sometimes posts on Truth Social even into the early morning hours as well. Trump revealed to Devine during their interview Saturday that the phrase always going through his head when he first gets up is “Business. Everything’s business.” He then elaborated on why these particular words go through his head and unsurprisingly took a deserved shot at Biden. “There’s no thoughts of leisure, no going to the beach like Sleepy Joe Biden did and falling asleep in front of the press,” Trump explained. “How do you fall asleep in front of the press?” This was an excellent point by Trump. It’s no wonder why the rest of the world sees an actual leader and is no longer laughing at us.
